integrity: Proof is a direct calculation of the Gaussian payoff-gradient vector field, a symmetry-reduced center-manifold coefficient, and the standard nonlinear stability argument. A standalone symbolic and numerical checker is supplied. No independent external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Local deterministic three-player Gaussian proportional-resource game with symmetric finitely supported resource law and competitive reach exactly at the variance-defined linear threshold; the equality kurtosis 13/12 and global stochastic dynamics are not determined.
title: Kurtosis determines nonlinear critical clustering in a three-player Gaussian resource game
